name: Pain
description: Suffering, Endurance, Injury, Torment, Clarity. Pain is not sadism — it is information, the body's most honest signal. Those attuned to it learn how pain moves through a body, how it compounds, how the expectation of it paralyzes, and that it is the most transferable substance there is: it can be shared, reflected, carried for someone else, and handed back to the one who caused it. Its currency is the Wound.

major.name: Crippled
major.card: speed 0 and disadvantage on Dexterity saves

offensive.name: Blood Price
offensive.description: Every wound a body carries is a door. You know where all of them are.

tiers.text: The damage becomes Psychic — it lands on the nerves, not the flesh — and every Wound the target already carries answers it: the effect deals one additional damage die for each of its Wounds, up to your Proficiency Bonus. It also causes a Wound at a quarter of the target's hit point maximum instead of half.
tiers.card: Damage becomes Psychic · +1 die for each Wound the target carries (max {PB}) · causes a Wound at ¼ of its max HP instead of ½

damage.extraDice: 1 per Wound on the target, max PB

wound.threshold: a quarter of its maximum HP

tiers.text: Pay the price. As you draw the seal you may take 1 Wound yourself, ignoring the one-Wound-per-turn limit. If you do, the seal's damage dice are treated as their maximum.
tiers.card: You may take 1 Wound as you cast — if you do, the damage dice count as their maximum

mech.maximize: the seal's damage dice, if you paid

tiers.text: The pain compounds. A Wound this effect causes ignores the one-per-turn limit and counts as two toward the target's next Injury.
tiers.card: The Wound it causes ignores the one-per-turn limit and counts as TWO toward an Injury

tiers.text: Breaking Point. If this effect gives the target an Injury, you choose the entry from the Injury table instead of rolling, and the target is Stunned until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: If this gives them an Injury, you pick it from the table — and they're Stunned until the end of their next turn

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

supportive.name: Agony Echo
supportive.description: The more they hurt you, the more they hurt themselves.

tiers.text: For the buff's duration, the target's pain echoes: once per round, when a creature within 30 feet of it damages it, that creature takes psychic damage equal to half the damage it dealt. There is no save — the signal simply arrives.
tiers.card: While the buff lasts, once a round, whoever damages the target from within 30 ft takes half that damage back as psychic

tiers.text: The echo is whole: the attacker takes the full damage it dealt, from as far as 60 feet away.
tiers.card: The echo returns the FULL damage, from up to 60 ft

tiers.text: Every blow echoes — there is no longer a limit per round — and Wounds echo too: whenever the target gains a Wound from a creature's attack or effect, that creature gains a Wound as well.
tiers.card: No limit per round · when the target gains a Wound from someone, they gain one too

tiers.text: Chain Reaction. Each echo also strikes up to two other enemies within 30 feet of the attacker for the same damage, and every creature the echo hits is Staggered — it loses its reaction and its speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: CHAIN REACTION — each echo also hits two more enemies near the attacker · all of them Staggered (no reactions, half speed)

reflect.chain: two more enemies within 30 ft of the attacker

supportive.name: Suffering Sustains
supportive.description: Past a certain threshold, a body stops being afraid and starts being present.

tiers.text: For the buff's duration, the target's Wounds stop working against it: they don't raise its death saving throw or Concentration DCs. While it has any Wounds it has advantage on Constitution saving throws.
tiers.card: While the buff lasts, its Wounds don't raise its death save or Concentration DCs · with any Wound: advantage on Con saves

tiers.text: They start working for it. It adds its Wound count (maximum your Proficiency Bonus) to its damage rolls and to its AC, and it can't be Frightened.
tiers.card: Adds its Wound count (max {PB}) to its damage and its AC · can't be Frightened

tiers.text: At half its hit points or lower, it regenerates: at the start of each of its turns it regains hit points equal to your Verum Modifier plus its Wound count.
tiers.card: At half HP or lower: regains {VM} + its Wound count at the start of each of its turns

tiers.text: Legendary Pain Response. When it would drop to 0 hit points, it drops to 1 instead and gains a Wound — once per turn, for as long as the buff lasts. While at a quarter of its hit points or lower it may take one additional action on each of its turns (not to draw a seal or cast a spell).
tiers.card: LEGENDARY PAIN RESPONSE — dropping to 0 leaves it at 1 and gives it a Wound (1/turn) · at ¼ HP or lower: one extra action each turn (no seals or spells)

buff.cheatDeath: once per turn, gaining a Wound
buff.actionEconomy: one extra action at a quarter HP or lower

supportive.name: Transference
supportive.description: Pain can be carried for someone. It has to be carried by someone.

tiers.text: Take the target's pain into yourself: move up to 1 of its Wounds to you (this ignores the one-per-turn limit). Until the buff ends, it can't be Frightened and its Concentration checks aren't raised by Wounds. Drawn on yourself, this seal instead numbs you: your Wounds impose nothing on you for the buff's duration.
tiers.card: Move 1 of its Wounds onto you · it can't be Frightened and its Wounds don't touch its Concentration while this lasts (Self: your Wounds impose nothing)

tiers.text: Move up to 2 Wounds from each target. Wounds you take this way don't count toward your own next Injury.
tiers.card: Up to 2 Wounds each · Wounds you carry for others don't count toward your Injury

tiers.text: You can carry the worst of it. Instead of Wounds, take one of a target's Injuries: it heals completely, and on you it becomes 2 Wounds.
tiers.card: Or take one of its INJURIES — it heals, and becomes 2 Wounds on you

tiers.text: And then you pass it on. When you take Wounds this way, one hostile creature within 60 feet that you can see gains the same number — no save; the pain simply goes where you send it.
tiers.card: Pass it on — a hostile creature within 60 ft you can see gains as many Wounds as you just took, no save

wound.pass: the same number to a hostile creature within 60 ft

control.name: Torturer's Focus
control.description: The expectation of pain paralyzes better than pain does.

tiers.text: A creature that fails flinches from what it knows is coming: until the end of its next turn it has disadvantage on attack rolls and on Concentration checks.
tiers.card: Fail: disadvantage on attacks and Concentration checks until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: Its pain is laid bare. While the effect lasts, it loses resistance to psychic damage, and each Wound it carries gives it −1 on saving throws.
tiers.card: While this lasts: no resistance to psychic · −1 to its saves for every Wound it carries

tiers.text: Dread. The creature is Frightened of you. If it carries 3 or more Wounds, it is Stunned by anticipation instead, until the end of its next turn.
tiers.card: Frightened of you · with 3+ Wounds, Stunned until the end of their next turn instead

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.duration: until the end of its next turn

tiers.text: Nothing heals. While the effect lasts, the creature automatically fails death saving throws, cannot lose Wounds by any means, and any Injury it gains is permanent unless healed by Greater Restoration or stronger magic.
tiers.card: While this lasts: auto-fails death saves, can't lose Wounds, and any Injury it gains is permanent short of Greater Restoration

control.name: Crippling Wound
control.description: Your seal rends more than flesh.

tiers.text: A creature that fails gains 1 Wound, ignoring the one-per-turn limit. Name the limb or organ it lands on.
tiers.card: Fail: 1 Wound on a limb or organ you name (ignores the one-per-turn limit)

tiers.text: The Wound cripples. Choose one until the end of its next turn: its speed is halved; it has disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saving throws; or it drops what it holds in one hand and can't use that hand.
tiers.card: The Wound cripples — pick one: half speed, disadvantage on Dex checks and saves, or it drops what's in one hand and can't use it

choice: disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves

tiers.text: It gains 2 Wounds instead of 1. If that brings it to an Injury, you choose the entry from the Injury table instead of rolling.
tiers.card: 2 Wounds instead of 1 · if that makes an Injury, you pick it from the table

tiers.text: Name a body part as you draw the seal — heart, lungs, eyes, spine. An Injury this effect causes lands there, and it is permanent unless restored by 7th-level vitaemancy or divine intervention.
tiers.card: Name a body part — an Injury this causes lands there, permanent short of 7th-level vitaemancy or a god

mech.injury: lands on a named body part; permanent short of 7th-level vitaemancy

utility.name: Read the Hurt
utility.description: Pain is the body's most honest signal.

tiers.text: Learn every injury, illness, and old wound a creature carries by touch, and how each was earned — including its current Wounds and Injuries. With consent, deaden or restore a creature's sense of pain for 1 hour.
tiers.card: Read every injury, Wound and old scar by touch, and how each was earned · deaden or restore pain 1 hr

tiers.text: Know when a creature within 60 feet is lying about how it feels — pain, fear, or exhaustion it is hiding. Ease a willing creature's chronic pain for 24 hours.
tiers.card: Know when someone within 60 ft hides pain, fear or exhaustion · ease chronic pain 24 hrs

tiers.text: Take a willing creature's pain into yourself for up to 1 hour — you feel it, they do not, and neither of you takes damage from the transfer.
tiers.card: Take a willing creature's pain into yourself up to 1 hr — neither of you takes damage

tiers.text: Read a body's entire history of suffering — every wound and every hand that dealt it, in order. Or grant a willing creature a full day without pain, however they came by it.
tiers.card: Read a body's whole history of suffering, in order · or give someone a full day without pain

complementEffects.name: Nerve Strike
complementEffects.description: The spell finds the places that hurt most.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw, the target takes bonus psychic damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (min 1d6), and has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
effect.card: +1 die psychic · disadvantage on their next attack

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The bonus damage increases to two dice, and the disadvantage covers all its attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · disadvantage on all their attacks until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The bonus damage increases to three dice, and the Concentration check this damage forces is made at disadvantage.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · the Concentration check it forces is at disadvantage

penalty.disadvantage: the Concentration check this damage forces

complementEffects.name: Martyr's Guard
complementEffects.description: Wounds become walls — and someone has to hold them up.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, each of its targets gains a bonus to AC and saving throws equal to its Wound count (minimum +1, maximum +3) until the start of your next turn. You carry some of it: you take psychic damage equal to twice the slot level.
effect.card: The seal's targets: + their Wound count (min 1, max 3) to AC and saves until your next turn · you take 2 × {SLOT} psychic

mech.cost: you take psychic damage equal to twice the slot level

upgrades.text: Level 5+: The bonus lasts 1 minute, and the targets' Wounds don't raise their death saving throw DC while it does.
upgrades.card: Lasts 1 min · their Wounds don't raise their death save DC

upgrades.text: Level 11+: The guard no longer costs you anything.

effect.text: Creatures that fail the seal's save are Staggered: they lose their reaction and their speed is halved until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Those who fail are Staggered — no reactions, half speed until the end of their next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: A Staggered creature also has disadvantage on the first saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: Also disadvantage on their first save before the end of their next turn

penalty.disadvantage: its first saving throw before the end of its next turn

upgrades.text: Level 11+: A Staggered creature also can't take bonus actions until the end of its next turn.
upgrades.card: Also no bonus actions until the end of their next turn
